custodial_manifestation.authority_note: AguaYLuz is the pinned producer manifestation/custodian only; it does not supersede the external Census source authority or the federation shared-geometry authority.

projection_policy: Repository-local copies are read-only projections/caches. A different source revision requires a new manifest and compatibility/adjudication receipt before promotion.
containment_policy: Cross-repository municipio/barrio containment MUST use this pinned manifestation or a certified successor; producer-local centroids or fuzzy place names cannot override polygon containment.
open_metadata: Exact upstream Census release/vintage is not asserted by this manifest because current repository evidence does not prove it. This does not prevent byte-level authority for the frozen manifestation, but upstream-vintage recovery is required before calling the external-source lineage fully certified.
